info.title: A Prime Transport ERP
info.description: Transport & Logistics ERP – REST API. Authenticate with POST /api/auth/login and send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

post.description: Short-lived (2 minute) link for one GET path, for app download managers that cannot send headers.
Record an e-way bill generated on the portal (or update Part-B vehicle). The API route is used when configured.
Book a matched FASTag debit as a trip toll expense (paid from FASTag wallet).
Record an IRN obtained on the IRP portal (offline/bulk tool). The user attests that the IRP issued it.
Import journal vouchers in the same layout as the Tally export (one row per ledger line, grouped by Voucher Number).

get.description: Resolve a scanned barcode / QR: item barcode, SKU, 'ITEM:<sku>|BATCH:<no>' labels or an LR number.
Complete data export: one Excel workbook with a sheet per table (secrets excluded).
